title: Unconditional Lock Contention in Telemetry/Observability Paths
pattern: Acquiring global resource locks to construct, format, or process telemetry messages before checking if the diagnostic/debug layer is actively enabled, or doing heavy formatting under lock.
why_bad: Telemetry gathering should be low-overhead. Holding lock guards over expensive allocation or formatting operations blocks critical concurrent work and causes latency spikes under load [239, 667-668].
detection: Lock acquisition directly wrapping string formatters, vector expansion, or system metrics generation code.
fix: Move the diagnostic flag check to the absolute front of the execution pathway, copy raw data inside a brief lock, and perform formatting asynchronously or outside the lock boundary.
